name: Island Terrain 3D Model
notes: Detailed 3D island terrain -> OBJ. Outer outline = the octagonal table boundary (Elevations_with_Final_Table.pdf); no blue ocean in that PDF, so everything between the octagon outline and the outermost (pink) contour is ocean. Inch dims on the octagon are reference-only; model keeps standard scaling (largest extent -> ~20km). Units meters, altitude +Y, sea level 0, peak +1500m, ocean-floor rim -1500m (outline = model limit; sea bed gently slopes out to it). Contour PDF used only as a MACRO guide (peak/coast/boundary), not exact contours. Fine relief generated procedurally to match the reference image's detail level (rugged ridges via domain-warped ridged+fBm noise) then carved with hydraulic erosion (~325k droplets) for dendritic valleys. terrain.py builds the heightfield; generate.py clips to the octagon domain and closes a watertight solid (surface + skirt + base) and exports OBJ+GLB. Peak pinned to +1500, floor -1500, sea level 0. ~261k verts, watertight. Horizontal extent ~18.8x20km (TARGET_MAX_EXTENT_M), grid N=620 (raise for more detail). The provided jpg is a detail reference, NOT a surface texture; final model is geometry only.
